text: Let us see what you have made.
Clean work. It sits well in the hand.
Rough. Finish it before you bring it to me.
Through the rope. A keen edge.
The rope is still hanging.
The edge gives on the rod, and comes back.
The edge did not survive the rod.
Through the timber, and the edge held.
The timber won.
Still shaving after the chop. Good.
It will not shave now.
It glides. A cook will thank you.
It drags on the board.
It took the bend.
It snapped too soon.
It springs back true.
It did not come back true.
A clean cut through the mat.
The mat is still standing.
Every test passed. A sound blade.
Not yet. Read the card, and try again.
The Guild is satisfied. Well done, smith.
Not this time. The Guild will see you at the next Proving.
